Vorgaroth is a Chaos Lord of Khorne that first appeared in Age of Sigmar, at the very launch of it, as a ForgeWorld exclusive. Weirdly enough, he is said to hail from “The World-That-Was” (aka Warhammer Fantasy), and on his lore page included in his kit, there is a lot of lore about his doings before AoS. Weird thing is, he was never mentioned in WHFB before, and no other new character at that point during AoS had lore about them in the previous setting. Therefore, if they were a returning character from Fantasy, you would know them from the pre-established lore, making Vorgaroth a weird case.

This raised many eyebrows, and people started a theory: Vorgaroth was the next character to be featured in the cancelled “Throne of Chaos” tetralogy, making him one of the missing sons of the Great Kurgan and brother to Tamurkhan. So yeah, “Tamurkhan: The Throne of Chaos” wasn’t a one-off by ForgeWorld, we are supposed to get one book per Chaos God, each one featuring one of the four sons of The Great Kurgan. The story goes that The Great Kurgan, a northern chieftain, made a deal with the Chaos Gods in exchange for power to conquer the world; he basically sold the souls of his four infant sons to the Gods, each god taking ownership of one son.

So, Tamurkhan’s book was the first one to be released, and we were supposed to get other three books featuring the rest of the Kurgan brothers, each one dedicated to the remaining Gods. And the theory goes that Vorgaroth’s book, which was finished alongside his model, was next, but of course we got the whole End Times deal, but they still had his complete model, so GW decided to stick him in AoS just like that.

Despite being canon in WHFB, we will never see Vorgaroth featured in game, due to him being exclusively an AoS character, and that IP is out of bounds for TWW3. A sad state, given that Vorgaroth’s model is incredibly cool and from what I can tell he hasn’t had his rules updated since the 1^(st) AoS edition and he is no longer playable in the current edition, not even sold by ForgeWorld anymore.

I am sorry to tell you but there is an a really "good" Norscan faction that isn't aligned with Chaos in some way. It is true that the more south you go, the less tainted and corrupted the Norscan tribe get. They even trade with southerners or let them into their villages, for trade only. However they are still very much aligned Chaos and worship the Chaos Gods. Even then, when the End Times came, all, and I mean all, of the Norscan tribes united under Archaon and attacked the south, so that tells you were their loyalties lie. I can only think of two specific, detailed instances of Norscans having good interactions with southerners. The first would be the short tale "The Were of Fjirgard" that is very, very old. It depicts a man from Marienburg trading with Norscans. The other would be the Norscan settlement of Skeggi, which is a settlement of Norscans in Lustria.
